target: acceptance 3 — an empty but well-formed catalog is unverifiable, NOT three simultaneously-dead aliases, which would read as catastrophic when the likeliest cause is an upstream hiccup
cmd: printf "OPENROUTER_API_KEY=or-test\n" > .env; printf ".env\n" > .gitignore; OPENROUTER_CATALOG_FILE="$FIXTURES/alias-liveness/catalog-empty.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/doctor.sh" > out 2>&1; grep -i 'could not' out; if grep -qi 'not in the openrouter catalog' out; then echo REPORTED_AS_DEAD; fi
